title: The Effects of Human Capital Accumulation on Climate Beliefs and Behaviors
The Unseen Costs of Blue Skies: Pollutant Substitution and Biodiversity Loss
abstract: Incomplete performance metrics distort incentives. Exploiting the staggered roll-out of China’s national air monitoring network, we document a pollutant substitution effect: PM2.5 fell significantly, yet O3 surged. We trace this to strategic behavior: facing binding PM2.5 targets, local governments prioritized abatement of particulate precursors while neglecting ozone precursors. Critically, this was not a benign trade-off. Although the policy reduced PM2.5-attributed deaths, the policy-induced O3 surge increased O3-attributed mortality and reduced biodiversity (measured by bird abundance). Conservative estimates suggest these costs reduced the policy’s net benefits by approximately 23.8%. Our findings highlight the hidden social costs of narrow performance targeting. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 不完整的绩效指标会扭曲激励。利用中国国家空气监测网络分阶段推广这一外生冲击，我们记录了一种污染物替代效应：PM2.5显著下降，但O3大幅上升。我们将其追溯至策略性行为：面对具有约束力的PM2.5目标，地方政府优先治理颗粒物前体，而忽视了臭氧前体。关键在于，这并非无害的权衡。尽管该政策减少了归因于PM2.5的死亡人数，但政策引发的O3激增增加了归因于O3的死亡人数，并降低了生物多样性（以鸟类数量衡量）。保守估计表明，这些成本使该政策的净收益减少了约23.8%。我们的发现凸显了狭隘绩效考核目标所隐含的社会成本。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Where There’s Smoke: Stochastic Caregiving Shocks and Mothers’ Labor Market Outcomes
Combating Cross-Border Externalities: Evidence from China’s Inter-Provincial Ecological Compensation Initiatives
Going Green in China: Firms’ Responses to Stricter Environmental Regulations
abstract: This paper examines the effect of stringent environmental regulations on firms' environmental practices, economic performance, and environmental innovation. Reducing COD levels by 10% relative to 2005 levels is an aim of the Chinese 11th Five-Year Plan. Using a difference-indifferences framework based on a comprehensive firm-level dataset, we find that more stringent environmental regulations faced by firms are positively associated with a greater probability of reducing COD emissions; also, there exists an evident heterogeneous effect across industries with different pollution intensities. Stricter environmental regulations also account for the sharp decline in firms' profits, capital, and labor. After executing a complete chain of tests of the underlying mechanisms, we find that firms rely more on recycling and abatement investment than on innovations when meeting environmental requirements.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了严格的环境监管对企业环境实践、经济绩效和环境创新的影响。中国“十一五”规划的目标之一是，将化学需氧量（COD）水平较2005年降低10%。我们基于一个全面的企业层面数据集，采用双重差分框架进行分析，发现企业所面临的环境监管越严格，其减少COD排放的概率就越大；同时，在不同污染强度的行业之间存在明显的异质性效应。更严格的环境监管也是导致企业利润、资本和劳动力急剧下降的原因。在对潜在机制进行了一整套完整的检验之后，我们发现，企业在满足环境要求时，更多依赖回收利用和治理投资，而非创新。

title: Private Adoption of Public Good Technologies: The Case of PurpleAir in California
Quality Signaling and Demand for Renewable Energy Technology - Evidence from a Randomized Field Experiment
abstract: Solar technologies have been associated with private and social returns, but their technological potential often remains unachieved because of persistently low demand for high-quality products. In a randomized field experiment in Senegal, we assess the potential of three types of quality signaling to increase demand for high-quality solar lamps. We find no effect on demand when consumers are offered a money-back guarantee but increased demand with a third-party certification or warranty, consistent with the notion that consumers are uncertain about product durability rather than their utility. However, despite the higher willingness to pay, the prices they would pay are still well below market prices for the average household, suggesting that reducing information asymmetries alone is insufficient to encourage wider adoption. Surprisingly, we also find that the effective quality signals in our setting stimulate demand for low-quality products by creating product-class effects among those least familiar with the product.
abstract_zh: 太阳能技术已被证明具有私人与社会回报，但由于高质量产品的需求长期低迷，其技术潜力往往未能充分实现。在塞内加尔开展的一项随机现场实验中，我们评估了三类质量信号提高高质量太阳能灯需求的潜力。当向消费者提供退款保证时，我们未发现需求受到影响；而提供第三方认证或质保时，需求则有所增加。这与如下观点一致：消费者对产品的耐用性存在不确定性，而非对其效用不确定。然而，尽管支付意愿有所提高，他们愿意支付的价格仍远低于普通家庭的市场价格，这表明仅减少信息不对称不足以促进更广泛的采用。出乎意料的是，我们还发现，在我们的情境中，有效的质量信号也会通过在对该产品最不熟悉的人群中形成产品类别效应，刺激对低质量产品的需求。

title: Science Philanthropy’s Implications for American Leadership in Innovation
Temperature Extremes Impact Mortality and Morbidity Differently
abstract: Increased temperature-related mortality is predicted to be one of the largest contributors to future economic damages from climate change globally, with declines in cold-related deaths in some regions outweighed by increases in heat-related deaths in others. Changes in temperature could also affect non-fatal health outcomes, whose aggregate societal burden is large, yet much less is known about how temperature affects the overall level and distribution of morbidity. Using georeferenced data on emergency department visits, mortality, and daily temperatures across California from 2006-2017, we show that the effect of temperature on mortality differs substantially from its effect on ED visits: mortality increases under extreme heat and cold, whereas ED visits increase under extreme heat but decline under extreme cold. These differential responses fundamentally shape the burden of future climate change: we predict that mortality in California will decrease by 0.32% due to changes in temperatures by mid-century, with declining cold deaths outweighing increasing heat deaths, but that ED visits will increase by 0.46% over the same period in the state, representing a total of 1.9 million excess visits. Our findings suggest that projected impacts of future warming on mortality, including benefits in many areas, might be a poor guide for morbidity impacts.
abstract_zh: 预计与温度相关的死亡人数增加，将是未来气候变化在全球范围内造成经济损失的最大来源之一：在某些地区，与寒冷相关的死亡减少，但在另一些地区，与高温相关的死亡增加，二者相抵后仍有净增长。温度变化还可能影响非致命性健康结果，其总体社会负担十分巨大，然而，人们对温度如何影响发病的总体水平与分布却知之甚少。利用2006至2017年加利福尼亚州急诊就诊、死亡及逐日气温的地理参照数据，我们表明，温度对死亡率的影响与其对急诊就诊的影响有显著差异：极端高温与极端低温都会使死亡率上升，而极端高温会使急诊就诊增加，极端低温却会使急诊就诊减少。这些不同的反应从根本上塑造了未来气候变化的负担：我们预测，到本世纪中叶，由于气温变化，加利福尼亚州的死亡人数将减少0.32%，与寒冷相关的死亡减少幅度超过与高温相关的死亡增加幅度；但在同一时期，该州的急诊就诊人次将增加0.46%，合计增加约190万次额外就诊。我们的发现表明，对未来变暖的死亡率影响的预测（包括许多地区可能获得的益处），可能是发病率影响的一个较差指引。

title: A Cold Stop: Temperature, Unemployment and Joblessness Dynamics
abstract: We provide new evidence that short-run temperature shocks affect unemployment dynamics. Linking daily weather data with three decades of Current Population Survey microdata, we show that cold, but not hot, temperatures significantly increase unemployment risk. This effect is concentrated in climate-exposed industries and driven by both increased job separations and longer unemployment durations. Separations appear to be driven by a rise in layoffs rather than quits, while the increase in unemployment duration is largely explained by a decline in employer vacancy postings. Taken together, temperature-induced joblessness dynamics are primarily demanddriven, rather than a result of changes in worker behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了新的证据，表明短期温度冲击会影响失业动态。通过将逐日天气数据与三十年的当期人口调查（CPS）微观数据相联结，我们表明，寒冷而非炎热的气温会显著增加失业风险。这一效应集中于气候暴露型行业，并且由工作分离增加和失业持续时间延长共同驱动。工作分离似乎是由裁员而非主动离职的增加所驱动，而失业持续时间的延长在很大程度上可以由雇主招聘岗位的减少来解释。综合来看，温度引起的失业动态主要是需求驱动的，而非劳动者行为变化的结果。

title: It's a Match! Team Composition and Performance in Innovation-Related Tasks
Modeling the Impact of a Supervised Consumption Site on HIV and HCV Transmission Among People Who Inject Drugs in Three California Counties, USA
The Coal Transition and Its Implications for Health and Housing Values
abstract: During the past fifteen years, more than 30% of US coal plants have had at least one coal-fired generator close. We utilize this natural experiment to estimate the effect of coal plant exposure on mortality and house values. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that, despite the fact that most of this coal generation is replaced with natural gas generation, individuals in counties whose population centroid is within 30 miles of a plant that closes at least one coal-fired unit experience large health effects following shutdown. While these health improvements appear to capitalize into housing values, they only do so for homes within 15 miles of the plant and only when the retirement is complete rather than partial. Taken together, these results underscore the importance of subjective perceptions in shaping market-mediated price effects with far-reaching implications for the literature.
abstract_zh: 在过去十五年中，超过30%的美国燃煤电厂至少有一台燃煤发电机组关闭。我们利用这一自然实验，估计燃煤电厂暴露对死亡率和房屋价值的影响。采用双重差分设计，我们发现，尽管大部分燃煤发电被天然气发电所取代，但在人口重心距离至少关闭一台燃煤机组的电厂30英里以内的县中，居民在电厂关闭后经历了显著的健康改善。尽管这些健康改善似乎已资本化到房屋价值中，但这种资本化仅出现在距电厂15英里以内的住房上，并且只有在完全退役而非部分退役的情况下才会发生。综合来看，这些结果强调了主观感知在塑造市场中介价格效应方面的重要性，并对相关文献具有深远的影响。

title: Evolution of the One CGIAR‘s Research and Innovation Portfolio to 2030: Approaches, Tools, and Insights after the Reform
How Hurricanes Sweep Up Housing Markets: Evidence from Florida
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 118(2023): 102770
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of hurricanes on the housing market and the associated implications for local population turnover. We first characterize the post-hurricane equilibrium dynamics in local housing markets using microdata from Florida during 2000-2016.Our results show that hurricanes cause an increase in equilibrium prices and a concurrent decrease in transactions in affected areas, both lasting up to three years. Together, these dynamics imply a negative transitory shock to the housing supply as a consequence of the hurricane. Furthermore, we match buyer characteristics from mortgage applications to provide the first buyer-level evidence on population turnover. We find that incoming homeowners in this period have higher incomes, leading to an overall shift in the local economic profile toward higher-income groups. Our findings suggest that market responses to destructive natural disasters can lead to uneven and lasting demographic changes in affected communities, even with a full recovery in physical capital.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了飓风对住房市场的影响，以及由此对当地人口更替产生的影响。我们首先利用2000至2016年间佛罗里达州的微观数据，刻画了飓风过后当地住房市场的均衡动态。结果表明，飓风导致受灾地区的均衡价格上升，同时成交量下降，且这两种效应均持续长达三年。这些动态共同意味着，飓风造成了住房供给的暂时性负向冲击。此外，我们将抵押贷款申请中的买方特征进行匹配，首次提供了买方层面的人口更替证据。我们发现，这一时期迁入的住房所有者收入更高，从而使当地经济结构整体上向高收入群体转移。我们的发现表明，即使实物资本已完全恢复，市场对毁灭性自然灾害的反应也可能导致受灾社区出现不均衡且持久的人口结构变化。

title: Unit Costs of Needle and Syringe Program Provision: A Global Systematic Review and Cost Extrapolation
When Externalities Collide: Influenza and Pollution
abstract: Influenza and air pollution each pose significant public health risks with large global economic consequences. The common pathways through which each harms health presents an interesting case of compounding risk via interacting externalities. Using instrumental variables based on changing wind directions, we show increased levels of contemporaneous pollution significantly increase influenza hospitalizations. We exploit random variations in the effectiveness of the influenza vaccine as an additional instrument to show vaccine protection neutralizes this relationship. This suggests seemingly disparate policy actions of pollution control and vaccination campaigns jointly provide greater returns than those implied by addressing either in isolation.
abstract_zh: 流感和空气污染各自都对公共健康构成重大风险，并带来巨大的全球经济后果。两者损害健康的共同路径，构成了一个通过相互作用的外部性而产生叠加风险的有趣案例。利用基于风向变化的工具变量，我们表明，同期污染水平的上升会显著增加流感住院人数。我们利用流感疫苗有效性的随机变化作为额外的工具变量，表明疫苗保护可以抵消这一关系。这表明，看似截然不同的污染控制政策与疫苗接种运动，共同所产生的回报，将大于单独应对其中任何一项所产生的回报。

title: Choose Your Moments: Peer Review and Scientific Risk Taking
Disparities in Pollution Capitalization Rates: The Role of Direct & Systemic Discrimination
abstract: We examine how exogenous changes in air pollution exposure over the past two decades have altered disparities in home values between Black and White homeowners. We find that air quality capitalization rates are significantly lower for Black homeowners, so much lower that, despite secular reductions in the Black-White pollution exposure gap, housing value disparities increased. An exploration of mechanisms suggests 60% of this difference is attributable to seller race and 40% to racial neighborhood composition, robust to a range of seller, property and neighborhood characteristics. We discuss our findings through the lens of direct and systemic discrimination in housing markets.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了过去二十年空气污染暴露的外生变化，如何改变了黑人与白人房主之间的房屋价值差距。我们发现，黑人房主的空气质量资本化率显著更低，低到即使黑人与白人之间的污染暴露差距长期呈下降趋势，房屋价值差距仍然扩大。对作用机制的探讨表明，这一差异的60%可归因于卖方的种族，40%可归因于种族化的社区构成，且该结论在一系列卖方、房产和社区特征下依然稳健。我们从住房市场中的直接歧视与系统性歧视的视角，对研究结果进行了讨论。

title: Science, Philanthropy, and American Leadership
Naturally Occurring Combinations of Receptors from Single Cell Transcriptomics in Endothelial Cells
Regional Research-Practice-Policy Partnerships in Response to Climate-Related Disparities: Promoting Health Equity in the Pacific
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health (19)2022: 9758
abstract: Although climate change poses a threat to health and well-being globally, a regional approach to addressing climate-related health equity may be more suitable, appropriate, and appealing to under-resourced communities and countries. In support of this argument, this commentary describes an approach by a network of researchers, practitioners, and policymakers dedicated to promoting climate-related health equity in Small Island Developing States and low- and middle-income countries in the Pacific. We identify three primary sets of needs related to developing a regional capacity to address physical and mental health disparities through research, training, and assistance in policy and practice implementation: (1) limited healthcare facilities and qualified medical and mental health providers; (2) addressing the social impacts related to the cooccurrence of natural hazards, disease outbreaks, and complex emergencies; and (3) building the response capacity and resilience to climate-related extreme weather events and natural hazards.
abstract_zh: 尽管气候变化在全球范围内对健康和福祉构成威胁，但对于资源匮乏的社区和国家而言，以区域为基础的方法来应对与气候相关的健康公平问题，可能更为适宜、恰当且更具吸引力。为支持这一论点，本评论描述了一个由研究人员、从业者和政策制定者组成的网络所采取的做法，该网络致力于在小岛屿发展中国家以及太平洋地区的中低收入国家促进与气候相关的健康公平。我们确定了三类主要需求，它们与通过研究、培训以及政策与实践实施协助，发展区域能力以应对身心健康不平等密切相关：（1）医疗设施有限，合格的医疗和心理健康服务人员短缺；（2）应对自然灾害、疾病暴发与复杂突发事件同时发生所带来的社会影响；（3）建立应对与气候相关的极端天气事件和自然灾害的响应能力与韧性。

title: The Risk of Caution: Evidence from an Experiment
This is Air: The ‘Non-Health’ Effects of Air Pollution
abstract: A robust body of evidence shows that air pollution exposure is detrimental to health outcomes, often measured as deaths and hospitalizations. This literature has focused less on subclinical channels that nonetheless impact behavior, performance, and skills. This article reviews the economic research investigating the causal effects of pollution on "non-health" endpoints, including labor productivity, cognitive performance, and multiple forms of decision making. Subclinical effects of pollution can be more challenging to observe than formal health care encounters but may be more pervasive if they affect otherwise healthy people. The wide variety of possible impacts of pollution should be informed by plausible mechanisms and require appropriate hypothesis testing to limit false discovery. Finally, any detected effects of pollution, both in the short and long run, may be dampened by costly efforts to avoid exposure ex-ante and remediate its impacts ex-post; these costs must be considered for a full welfare analysis
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，空气污染暴露对健康结果有害，通常以死亡和住院来衡量。这一文献较少关注那些仍会影响行为、表现和技能的亚临床渠道。本文综述了考察污染对“非健康”终点的因果效应的经济学研究，这些终点包括劳动生产率、认知表现以及多种形式的决策。污染的亚临床效应可能比正式的医疗就诊更难观察，但如果它们影响的是原本健康的人群，则可能更为普遍。污染可能产生的各种影响，应当以合理的机制为依据，并需要进行适当的假设检验，以限制错误发现。最后，无论是短期还是长期检测到的污染效应，都可能因事前为避免暴露、事后为修复影响而付出的高昂代价而被削弱；为进行完整的福利分析，必须考虑这些成本。

title: Incentivizing Learning-By-Doing: The Role of Compensation Schemes
Temperature and Work: Time Allocated to Work under Varying Climate and Labor Market Conditions
abstract: Workers in climate exposed industries such as agriculture, construction, and manufacturing face increased health risks of working on high temperature days and may make decisions to reduce work on high-heat days to mitigate this risk. Utilizing the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) for the period 2003 through 2018 and historical weather data, we model the relationship between daily temperature and time allocation, focusing on hours worked by high-risk laborers. The results indicate that labor allocation decisions are context specific and likely driven by supply-side factors. We do not find a significant relationship between temperature and hours worked during the Great Recession (2008–2014), perhaps due to high competition for employment, however during periods of economic growth (2003–2007, 2015–2018) we find a significant reduction in hours worked on high-heat days. During periods of economic growth, for every degree above 90 on a particular day, the average high-risk worker reduces their time devoted to work by about 2.6 minutes relative to a 90-degree day. This effect is expected to intensify in the future as temperatures rise. Applying the modeled relationships to climate projections through the end of century, we find that annual lost wages resulting from decreased time spent working on days over 90 degrees across the United States range from $36.7 to $80.0 billion in 2090 under intermediate and high emission futures, respectively.
abstract_zh: 在农业、建筑和制造业等气候暴露型行业中工作的劳动者，在高温日工作面临更高的健康风险，因此可能会决定减少高温日的工作时间，以降低这一风险。利用2003至2018年的美国时间利用调查（ATUS）和历史气象数据，我们建立了逐日气温与时间分配之间的关系模型，重点关注高风险劳动者的工作时数。结果表明，劳动分配决策取决于具体情境，并且可能由供给侧因素驱动。在大衰退时期（2008–2014年），我们未发现气温与工作时数之间存在显著关系，这可能是由于就业竞争激烈所致；然而，在经济增长时期（2003–2007年、2015–2018年），我们发现高温日的工作时数显著减少。在经济增长时期，某一天的气温每超过90华氏度一度，平均而言，高风险劳动者相对于90华氏度的日子，其工作时间减少约2.6分钟。随着气温上升，这一效应预计将在未来加剧。将所建模的关系应用于截至本世纪末的气候预测，我们发现，在中等与高排放情景下，因超过90华氏度的日子工作时间减少而导致的美国年度工资损失，在2090年将分别达到367亿至800亿美元。

title: Using Crowd-Sourced Data to Assess the Temporal and Spatial Relationship between Indoor and Outdoor Particulate Matter
abstract: Using hourly measures across a full year of crowd-sourced data from over 1000 indoor and outdoor pollution monitors in the state of California, we explore the temporal and spatial relationship between outdoor and indoor particulate matter (PM) concentrations for different particle sizes. The scale of this study offers new insight into both average penetration rates and drivers of heterogeneity in the outdoor-indoor relationship. We find that an increase in the daily outdoor PM concentration of 10% leads to an average increase of 4.2-6.1% in indoor concentrations. The penetration of outdoor particles to the indoor environment occurs rapidly and almost entirely within 5 h. We also provide evidence showing that penetration rates are associated with building age and climatic conditions in the vicinity of the monitor. Since people spend a substantial amount of each day indoors, our findings fill a critical knowledge gap and have significant implications for government policies to improve public health through reductions in exposure to ambient air pollution.
abstract_zh: 利用加利福尼亚州超过1000个室内外污染监测仪一整年的逐小时众包数据，我们考察了不同粒径颗粒物（PM）浓度在室外与室内之间的时间和空间关系。本研究的规模为理解平均渗透率以及室内外关系异质性的驱动因素提供了新的见解。我们发现，室外日均PM浓度每增加10%，室内浓度平均增加4.2%至6.1%。室外颗粒物渗入室内环境的过程十分迅速，且几乎全部在5小时内完成。我们还提供了证据表明，渗透率与建筑年龄及监测点附近的气候条件相关。由于人们每天有相当长的时间待在室内，我们的发现填补了一项关键的知识空白，并对政府通过减少环境空气污染暴露来改善公众健康的政策具有重要意义。

title: Temperature and High-Stakes Cognitive Performance: Evidence from the National College Entrance Examination in China
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 104 (2020): 102365
abstract: We provide the first nation-wide estimates on temperature effects on high-stakes cognitive performance in a developing country using data from the National College Entrance Examination (NCEE) in China. The NCEE is one of the most important institutions in China and affects hundreds of millions of families. We find that a one-standard-deviation increase in temperature (3.29° C) decreases the total test score by 1.12% (9.62% of a standard deviation) and decreases the probability of getting into first-tier universities by 1.97% (4.38% of a standard deviation).This suggests that temperature plays an important role in high-stakes cognitive performance and has potentially far-reaching impacts for the careers and lifetime earnings of students.
abstract_zh: 我们利用中国全国普通高等学校招生考试（高考）的数据，首次给出了发展中国家温度对高风险认知表现影响的全国性估计。高考是中国最重要的制度之一，影响着数亿个家庭。我们发现，气温每上升一个标准差（3.29摄氏度），考试总分下降1.12%（相当于9.62%个标准差），进入一流大学的概率下降1.97%（相当于4.38%个标准差）。这表明，温度在高风险认知表现中扮演着重要角色，并可能对学生的职业发展和终身收入产生深远影响。

The Effect of Pollution on Worker Productivity: Evidence from Call-Center Workers in China
abstract: We investigate the effect of pollution on worker productivity in the service sector by focusing on two call centers in China. Using precise measures of each worker's daily output linked to daily measures of pollution and meteorology, we find that higher levels of air pollution decrease worker productivity by reducing the number of calls that workers complete each day. These results manifest themselves at commonly found levels of pollution in major cities throughout the developing and developed world, suggesting that these types of effects are likely to apply broadly. When decomposing these effects, we find that the decreases in productivity are explained by increases in time spent on breaks rather than the duration of phone calls. To our knowledge, this is the first study to demonstrate that the negative impacts of pollution on productivity extend beyond physically demanding tasks to indoor, white-collar work.
abstract_zh: 我们以中国两家呼叫中心为对象，考察了污染对服务业劳动生产率的影响。通过将每位员工每日产出的精确测量与每日污染和气象数据相联结，我们发现，较高的空气污染水平会减少员工每日完成的通话数量，从而降低劳动生产率。这些结果在发展中国家和发达国家主要城市中常见的污染水平下即已显现，表明此类效应很可能具有广泛的适用性。在对这些效应进行分解后，我们发现，生产率的下降是由休息时间的增加所解释的，而非通话时长的变化。据我们所知，这是首个证明污染对生产率的负面影响不仅限于体力劳动，也延伸至室内白领工作的研究。

title: Air Pollution's Hidden Impacts
Heat, Disparities, and Health Outcomes in San Diego County's Diverse Climate Zones
abstract: Climate variability and change are issues of growing public health importance. Numerous studies have documented risks of extreme heat on human health in different locations around the world. Strategies to prevent heat‐related morbidity and reduce disparities are possible but require improved knowledge of health outcomes during hot days at a small‐scale level as important within‐city variability in local weather conditions, socio‐demographic composition, and access to air conditioning (AC) may exist. We analyzed hospitalization data for three unique climate regions of San Diego County alongside temperature data spanning 14 years to quantify the health impact of ambient air temperature at varying exceedance threshold levels. Within San Diego, coastal residents were more sensitive to heat than inland residents. At the coast, we detected a health impact at lower temperatures compared to inland locations for multiple disease categories including heat illness, dehydration, acute renal failure, and respiratory disease. Within the milder coastal region where access to AC is not prevalent, heat‐related morbidity was higher in the subset of zip codes where AC saturation is lowest. We detected a 14.6% increase (95% confidence interval [4.5%, 24.6%]) in hospitalizations during hot weather in comparison to colder days in coastal locations where AC is less common, while no significant impact was observed in areas with higher AC saturation. Disparities in AC ownership were associated with income, race/ethnicity, and homeownership. Given that heat waves are expected to increase with climate change, understanding health impacts of heat and the role of acclimation is critical for improving outcomes in the future.
abstract_zh: 气候变异与变化日益成为重要的公共卫生问题。大量研究已经记录了世界各地极端高温对人类健康的风险。预防与热相关的发病并减少健康差距的策略是可行的，但需要在更小的空间尺度上更好地了解炎热日子中的健康结果，因为城市内部的当地天气条件、社会人口构成以及空调可及性可能存在重要的差异。我们分析了圣地亚哥县三个独特气候区的住院数据，并结合长达14年的气温数据，以量化不同超标阈值水平下环境气温对健康的影响。在圣地亚哥市内，沿海居民比内陆居民对高温更为敏感。在沿海地区，相较于内陆地区，我们在多个疾病类别中检测到了较低温度下的健康影响，包括中暑、脱水、急性肾衰竭和呼吸系统疾病。在空调普及率不高的温和沿海地区，热相关的发病率在空调饱和度最低的邮政编码区中更高。在空调较为少见的沿海地区，与较冷的日子相比，高温天气下住院人数增加了14.6%（95%置信区间为[4.5%，24.6%]），而在空调饱和度较高的地区则未观察到显著影响。空调拥有情况的差异与收入、种族/族裔以及住房所有权相关。鉴于热浪预计将随气候变化而增加，理解高温的健康影响以及适应（acclimation）的作用，对于未来改善健康结果至关重要。

title: Temperature and Human Capital in the Short-and Long-Run
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 5(2018): 77–105
abstract: We provide the first estimates of the potential impact of climate change on human capital, focusing on the impacts from both short-run weather and long-run climate. Exploiting the longitudinal structure of the NLSY79 and random fluctuations in weather across interviews, we identify the effect of temperature in models with child-specific fixed effects. We find that short-run changes in temperature lead to statistically significant decreases in cognitive performance on math (but not reading) beyond 26C (78.8F).In contrast, our long-run analysis, which relies upon long-difference and rich cross-sectional models, reveals no statistically significant relationship between climate and human capital. This finding is consistent with the notion that adaptation, particularly compensatory behavior, plays a significant role in limiting the long run impacts from short run weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们首次估计了气候变化对人力资本的潜在影响，重点关注短期天气与长期气候两方面的影响。利用NLSY79的纵向结构以及各次访谈之间天气的随机波动，我们在包含儿童个体固定效应的模型中识别温度的效应。我们发现，短期气温变化在超过26摄氏度（78.8华氏度）时，会导致数学（但非阅读）认知表现出现统计显著的下降。相比之下，我们依赖长差分和丰富的截面模型进行的长期分析，并未揭示气候与人力资本之间存在统计显著的关系。这一发现与如下观点一致：适应，特别是补偿性行为，在限制短期天气冲击的长期影响方面发挥了重要作用。

title: The Adoption of Climate Smart Agriculture: The Role of Information and Insurance under Climate Change
venue: in Climate Smart Agriculture - Building Resilience to Climate Change, D Zilberman, L Lipper, N McCarthy, S Asfaw, and G Branca (Eds.), Springer, 2018
abstract: Climate change adds to the existing challenges in improving crop productivity and welfare for smallholder agricultural households by affecting the mean and variability of weather conditions and the frequency of extreme weather events. In the face of such growing uncertainty, agricultural practices of small landholders need to be adapted to better manage the changing risk structures. Since government risk management programs may complement or substitute for farmer adaptation, this chapter examines how a range of institutional interventions might assist, obstruct, channel, or change smallholder agricultural adaptation to climate change. Taken together, our results underscore the importance of the informational role of the agriculture extension, suggest that insurance can lead to significant changes in farmer planting and land management decisions, and show how information about changing conditions and insurance can be complimentary in driving changes in farmer behavior.
abstract_zh: 气候变化通过影响天气状况的均值与变异性以及极端天气事件的发生频率，加剧了小农家庭提高作物产量和福利水平所面临的既有挑战。面对这种日益增长的不确定性，小规模土地所有者的农业生产方式需要做出调整，以更好地应对不断变化的风险结构。由于政府风险管理计划可能对农户的适应行为起到补充或替代作用，本章考察了一系列制度性干预如何促进、阻碍、引导或改变小农对气候变化的农业适应。综合来看，我们的结果强调了农业推广服务的信息作用，表明保险可以显著改变农户的种植和土地管理决策，并说明关于气候条件变化的信息与保险在驱动农户行为改变方面可以相互补充。

venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 4(2017): 505-542
abstract: This paper examines the impact of fetal exposure to air pollution on 4th grade test scores in Santiago, Chile. We rely on comparisons across siblings which address concerns about locational sorting and all other time-invariant family characteristics that can lead to endogenous exposure to poor environmental quality. We also exploit data on air quality alerts to help address concerns related to short-run time-varying avoidance behavior, which has been shown to be important in a number of other contexts. We find a strong negative effect from fetal exposure to carbon monoxide (CO) on math and language skills measured in 4th grade. These effects are economically significant and our back of the envelope calculations suggest that the 50% reduction in CO in Santiago between 1990 and 2005 increased lifetime earnings by approximately 100 million USD per birth cohort.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了胎儿期暴露于空气污染对智利圣地亚哥四年级学生考试成绩的影响。我们依托同胞兄弟姐妹之间的比较，以解决因居住地选择而产生的内生性问题，并控制所有不随时间变化的家庭特征，这些特征可能导致暴露于不良环境质量的内生性。我们还利用空气质量预警数据，以应对与短期内随时间变化的规避行为相关的担忧，此类行为在许多其他情境中已被证明十分重要。我们发现，胎儿期暴露于一氧化碳（CO）会对四年级时测得的数学和语言技能产生显著的负面影响。这些影响在经济上具有重要意义：我们的粗略测算表明，1990年至2005年间圣地亚哥CO排放量减少50%，使每个出生队列的终身收入增加了约1亿美元。

Early Life Exposure to the Great Smog of 1952 and the Development of Asthma
venue: American Journal of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, 194(2016): 1475–1482
abstract:
Little is known about the long-term effects of air pollution exposure and the root causes of asthma. We use exposure to intense air pollution from the 1952 Great Smog of London as a natural experiment to examine both issues.
To determine whether exposure to extreme air pollution in utero or soon after birth affects asthma development later in life.
This was a natural experiment using the unanticipated pollution event by comparing the prevalence of asthma between those exposed to the Great Smog in utero or the first year of life with those conceived well before or after the incident and those residing outside the affected area at the time of the smog.
Prevalence of asthma during childhood (ages 0–15) and adulthood (ages >15) is analyzed for 2,916 respondents to the Life History portion of the English Longitudinal Study on Aging born from 1945 to 1955. Exposure to the Great Smog in the first year of life increases the likelihood of childhood asthma by 19.87 percentage points (95% confidence interval [CI], 3.37–36.38). We also find suggestive evidence that early-life exposure led to a 9.53 percentage point increase (95% CI, −4.85 to 23.91) in the likelihood of adult asthma and exposure in utero led to a 7.91 percentage point increase (95% CI, −2.39 to 18.20) in the likelihood of childhood asthma.
These results are the first to link early-life pollution exposure to later development of asthma using a natural experiment, suggesting the legacy of the Great Smog is ongoing.
abstract_zh:
关于空气污染暴露的长期影响以及哮喘的根本成因，目前所知甚少。我们利用1952年伦敦大烟雾事件中的高强度空气污染作为自然实验，对这两个问题进行考察。
研究目的：确定子宫内或出生后不久暴露于极端空气污染，是否会影响其日后哮喘的发生。
研究设计：本研究以这一未曾预料的污染事件为自然实验，比较以下两组人群的哮喘患病率：一组是在子宫内或出生后第一年暴露于大烟雾的人群；另一组是在污染事件前后很久出生、或在事件发生时居住于受影响地区之外的人群。
研究对象与结果：本研究分析了英国老龄化纵向研究（English Longitudinal Study on Aging）生命史部分中1945年至1955年间出生的2,916名受访者在童年（0至15岁）和成年（15岁以上）时期的哮喘患病情况。出生后第一年暴露于大烟雾，使童年哮喘的发生概率增加19.87个百分点（95%置信区间[CI]为3.37至36.38）。我们还发现一些暗示性证据表明，早期生活暴露使成年哮喘的发生概率增加9.53个百分点（95% CI为-4.85至23.91），子宫内暴露使童年哮喘的发生概率增加7.91个百分点（95% CI为-2.39至18.20）。
研究结论：这些结果首次利用自然实验将早期生活污染暴露与其后哮喘的发生联系起来，表明大烟雾事件的遗留影响至今仍在持续。

title: Incorporating Environmental Outcomes into a Health Economic Model
venue: International Journal of Technology Assessment in Health Care, 32(2016): 400–406
abstract:
Objectives: Traditional economic evaluations for most health technology assessments (HTAs) have previously not included environmental outcomes. With the growing interest in reducing the environmental impact of human activities, the need to consider how to include environmental outcomes into HTAs has increased. We present a simple method of doing so.
Methods: We adapted an existing clinical-economic model to include environmental outcomes (carbon dioxide [CO2] emissions) to predict the consequences of adding insulin to an oral antidiabetic (OAD) regimen for patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) over 30 years, from the United Kingdom payer perspective. Epidemiological, efficacy, healthcare costs, utility, and carbon emissions data were derived from published literature. A scenario analysis was performed to explore the impact of parameter uncertainty.
Results: The addition of insulin to an OAD regimen increases costs by 2,668 British pounds per patient and is associated with 0.36 additional quality-adjusted life-years per patient. The insulin-OAD combination regimen generates more treatment and disease management-related CO2 emissions per patient (1,686 kg) than the OAD-only regimen (310 kg), but generates fewer emissions associated with treating complications (3,019 kg versus 3,337 kg). Overall, adding insulin to OAD therapy generates an extra 1,057 kg of CO2 emissions per patient over 30 years.
Conclusions: The model offers a simple approach for incorporating environmental outcomes into health economic analyses, to support a decision-maker's objective of reducing the environmental impact of health care. Further work is required to improve the accuracy of the approach; in particular, the generation of resource-specific environmental impacts.
abstract_zh:
目标：传统上，大多数卫生技术评估（HTA）的经济学评价并未纳入环境结果。随着人们对减少人类活动环境影响的关注日益增加，将环境结果纳入卫生技术评估的必要性也随之提高。本文提出一种简便的纳入方法。
方法：我们调整了一个现有的临床经济学模型，纳入环境结果（二氧化碳[CO2]排放），以预测在二型糖尿病（T2DM）患者的口服降糖药（OAD）方案中加入胰岛素，在未来30年内从英国付费方视角出发所产生的后果。流行病学、疗效、医疗费用、效用以及碳排放数据均来自已发表的文献。我们进行了情景分析，以考察参数不确定性的影响。
结果：在口服降糖药方案中加入胰岛素，每位患者的成本增加2,668英镑，并带来每位患者0.36个额外的质量调整生命年（QALY）。胰岛素与口服降糖药联合方案每位患者产生的治疗及疾病管理相关CO2排放（1,686千克）高于仅使用口服降糖药方案（310千克），但与并发症治疗相关的排放较少（3,019千克对比3,337千克）。总体而言，在口服降糖药治疗中加入胰岛素，30年内每位患者额外产生1,057千克CO2排放。
结论：该模型为将环境结果纳入卫生经济学分析提供了一种简便方法，有助于决策者实现减少医疗保健环境影响的目标。要提高该方法的准确性，仍需开展进一步工作，尤其是生成针对特定资源的环境影响数据。

title: Opportunities for Advances in Climate Change Economics
abstract: There have been dramatic advances in understanding the physical science of climate change, facilitated by substantial and reliable research support. The social value of these advances depends on understanding their implications for society, an arena where research support has been more modest and research progress slower. Some advances have been made in understanding and formalizing climate-economy linkages, but knowledge gaps remain [e.g., as discussed in (1, 2)]. We outline three areas where we believe research progress on climate economics is both sorely needed, in light of policy relevance, and possible within the next few years given appropriate funding: (i) refining the social cost of carbon (SCC), (ii) improving understanding of the consequences of particular policies, and (iii) better understanding of the economic impacts and policy choices in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 在可靠且获得大量支持的研究资助推动下，人们对气候变化物理科学的认识取得了显著进展。这些进展的社会价值，取决于人们对其社会影响的理解，而在这一领域，研究资助相对较少，研究进展也较为缓慢。在理解和形式化气候与经济之间的联系方面已取得一些进展，但仍存在知识空白[例如（1，2）中所讨论的]。鉴于政策相关性，并假设获得适当资助，我们概述了三个领域，我们认为这些领域的气候经济学研究进展既迫切需要，又有望在未来几年内实现：（i）完善社会碳成本（SCC）的估算；（ii）增进对特定政策后果的理解；以及（iii）更好地理解发展中经济体的经济影响和政策选择。

title: Particulate Pollution and the Productivity of Pear Packers
abstract: We study the effect of outdoor air pollution on the productivity of indoor workers at a pear-packing factory. We focus on fine particulate matter (PM2.5), a harmful pollutant that easily penetrates indoor settings. We find that an increase in PM2.5 outdoors leads to a statistically and economically significant decrease in packing speeds inside the factory, with effects arising at levels well below current air quality standards. In contrast, we find little effect of PM2.5 on hours worked or the decision to work, and little effect of pollutants that do not travel indoors, such as ozone. This effect of outdoor pollution on the productivity of indoor workers suggests a thus far overlooked consequence of pollution. Backof-the-envelope calculations suggest that nationwide reductions in PM2.5 from 1999 to 2008 generated $19.5 billion in labor cost savings, which is roughly one-third of the total welfare benefits associated with this change.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了室外空气污染对一家梨类包装工厂室内工人生产率的影响。我们关注细颗粒物（PM2.5），这是一种易于渗入室内环境的有害污染物。我们发现，室外PM2.5浓度上升会导致工厂内包装速度出现具有统计意义和经济意义的显著下降，且这一影响在远低于当前空气质量标准的污染水平下即已出现。相比之下，我们发现PM2.5对工作时长或是否工作的决定几乎没有影响，而不会渗入室内的污染物（如臭氧）同样几乎没有影响。室外污染对室内工人生产率的这一影响，表明了一种迄今被忽视的污染后果。粗略测算显示，1999年至2008年全国范围内的PM2.5减排产生了195亿美元的劳动力成本节约，约占此项变化相关福利收益总额的三分之一。

title: Screening for Acute HIV Infection in Community-based Settings: Cost Effectiveness and Impact on Transmissions
Temperature Extremes, Health, and Human Capital
abstract: The extreme temperatures expected under climate change may be especially harmful to children. Children are more vulnerable to heat partly because of their physiological features, but, perhaps more important, because they behave and respond differently than adults do. Children are less likely to manage their own heat risk and may have fewer ways to avoid heat; for example, because they don’t plan their own schedules, they typically can’t avoid activity during hot portions of the day. And very young children may not be able to tell adults that they’re feeling heat’s effects.
abstract_zh: 气候变化下预计出现的极端温度对儿童可能尤为有害。儿童更易受高温影响，部分原因在于其生理特征，但更重要的原因在于，他们的行为方式与应对方式不同于成年人。儿童较难管理自身的高温风险，且可用于躲避高温的方式也较少；例如，由于他们不自行安排日程，通常无法避开一天中炎热的时段进行活动。而且，非常年幼的儿童可能无法向成年人表达其感受到高温影响。

title: The Effects of Providing Fixed Compensation and Lottery-Based Rewards on Uptake of Medical Male Circumcision in Kenya: A Randomized Trial
Upgrading Efficiency and Behavior: Electricity Savings from Residential Weatherization Programs
abstract: Residential weatherization programs have become a major component of U.S. energy policy. Through these programs, households receive heavily subsidized energy efficiency upgrades as well as informational and behavioral treatments designed to encourage conservation. While previous work demonstrates that weatherization programs provide sizable energy savings, all have measured the composite effect of efficiency upgrades and behavioral treatments. In this paper, we present the first estimates which disentangle the energy savings provided by each of the individual interventions. Our results reveal that the actual energy savings achieved by the efficiency upgrades are substantially smaller than ex-ante, engineering predictions. Moreover, we present evidence that the energy savings provided by the simple behavioral interventions can exceed the savings resulting from the much more costly efficiency upgrades.
abstract_zh: 住宅保温改造项目已成为美国能源政策的重要组成部分。通过这些项目，家庭可获得大幅补贴的能源效率升级，以及旨在鼓励节约用能的信息和行为干预。尽管以往研究表明，保温改造项目能带来可观的节能效果，但所有研究衡量的都是效率升级与行为干预的综合效应。本文首次估计了各项干预措施各自所带来的节能效果。我们的结果显示，效率升级实际实现的节能量大大低于事前的工程预测。此外，我们提供的证据表明，简单的行为干预所带来的节能效果可以超过成本高得多的效率升级。

title: Industrial Productivity in a Hotter World: The Aggregate Implications of Heterogeneous Firm Investment in Air Conditioning

venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 69(2015): 36-52
abstract: Poverty and altered planning horizons brought on by the HIV/AIDS epidemic can change individual discount rates, altering incentives to conserve natural resources. Using longitudinal data from household surveys in western Kenya, we estimate impacts of health status on labor productivity and discount rates. We find that household size and composition are predictors of whether the effect on productivity dominates the discount rate effect, or vice-versa. Since households with more and younger members are better able to reallocate labor to cope with productivity shocks, the discount rate impact dominates for these households and health improvements lead to greater levels of conservation. In smaller families with less substitutable labor, the productivity impact dominates and health improvements lead to greater environmental degradation.
abstract_zh: 艾滋病疫情带来的贫困和规划期限的缩短，可能改变个体的贴现率，从而改变保护自然资源的激励。利用肯尼亚西部住户调查的纵向数据，我们估计了健康状况对劳动生产率和贴现率的影响。我们发现，家庭规模和构成可以预测生产率效应与贴现率效应孰占主导，或者反之。由于人口较多、较为年轻的家庭能够更好地重新配置劳动力以应对生产率冲击，因此对这些家庭而言贴现率效应占主导，健康状况改善会带来更高的保护水平。而在劳动力可替代性较弱的小家庭中，生产率效应占主导，健康状况改善反而导致更严重的环境退化。

abstract: Digital tracking and the proliferation of automated payments have made intermittent billing more commonplace, and the frequency at which consumers receive price, quantity, or total expenditure signals may distort their choices. This category of goods has expanded from household utilities, toll road access and software downloads to standard consumption goods paid by credit card or other "bill-me-later"-type systems. Yet we know surprisingly little about how these payment patterns affect decisions. This paper exploits hourly household electricity consumption data collected by "smart" electricity meters to examine dynamic consumer behavior under intermittent expenditure signals. Households reduce consumption by 0.6% to 1% following receipt of an electricity bill, but the response varies considerably by household type and season. Our results also suggest that spending "reminders" can reduce peak demand, particularly during summer months. We discuss the implications for energy policy when intermittent billing combined with inattention induces consumption cycles.
abstract_zh: 数字化追踪和自动支付的普及，使间歇性计费变得越来越常见，而消费者接收到价格、用量或总支出信号的频率，可能会扭曲其消费选择。此类商品的范围已从家庭公用事业、收费公路通行和软件下载，扩展到通过信用卡或其他“先消费后付款”式系统支付的普通消费品。然而，我们对这些支付模式如何影响决策的了解出奇地少。本文利用“智能”电表采集的逐小时家庭用电数据，考察间歇性支出信号下消费者的动态行为。家庭在收到电费账单后，用电量减少0.6%至1%，但这一反应因家庭类型和季节而有很大差异。我们的结果还表明，支出“提醒”可以降低高峰需求，尤其是在夏季。我们讨论了当间歇性计费与注意力不集中相结合、引发消费周期性波动时，对能源政策的启示。

title: Temperature and the Allocation of Time: Implications for Climate Change
abstract: In this paper we estimate the impacts of climate change on the allocation of time using econometric models that exploit plausibly exogenous variation in daily temperature over time within counties. We find large reductions in U.S. labor supply in industries with high exposure to climate and similarly large decreases in time allocated to outdoor leisure. We also find suggestive evidence of short-run adaptation through temporal substitutions and acclimatization. Given the industrial composition of the US, the net impacts on total employment are likely to be small, but significant changes in leisure time as well as large scale redistributions of income may be consequential. In developing countries, where the industrial base is more typically concentrated in climate-exposed industries and baseline temperatures are already warmer, employment impacts may be considerably larger.
abstract_zh: 本文利用计量经济模型估计了气候变化对时间配置的影响，该模型利用了县内每日气温随时间变化的、具有合理外生性的变异。我们发现，在受气候影响较大的行业中，美国劳动供给大幅减少，同时用于户外休闲的时间也出现了大幅下降。我们还发现了短期适应的暗示性证据，表现为时间上的替代和身体的适应性调整。鉴于美国的产业结构，气候变化对总就业的净影响可能较小，但休闲时间的显著变化以及大规模的收入再分配可能具有重要后果。在发展中国家，产业基础通常更集中于受气候影响较大的行业，且基准气温已经较高，因此就业影响可能要大得多。

title: Temporal and Spatial Heterogeneity of Marginal Emissions: Implications for Electric Cars and Other Electricity-Shifting Policies
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization, 107(2014): 248-268
abstract: In this paper, we develop a methodology for estimating marginal emissions of electricity demand that vary by location and time of day across the United States. The approach takes account of the generation mix within interconnected electricity markets and shifting load profiles throughout the day. Using data available for 2007 through 2009, with a focus on carbon dioxide (CO2), we find substantial variation among locations and times of day. Marginal emission rates are more than three times as large in the upper Midwest compared to the western United States, and within regions, rates for some hours of the day are more than twice those for others. We apply our results to an evaluation of plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs). The CO2 emissions per mile from driving PEVs are less than those from driving a hybrid car in the western United States and Texas. In the upper Midwest, however, charging during the recommended hours at night implies that PEVs generate more emissions per mile than the average car currently on the road. Underlying many of our results is a fundamental tension between electricity load management and environmental goals: the hours when electricity is the least expensive to produce tend to be the hours with the greatest emissions. In addition to PEVs, we show how our estimates are useful for evaluating the heterogeneous effects of other policies and initiatives, such as distributed solar, energy efficiency, and real-time pricing.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于估计美国各地区及一天中各时段电力需求的边际排放量，这些排放量随地点和时间而变化。该方法考虑了互联电力市场内的发电结构，以及一天之内不断变化的负荷曲线。利用2007年至2009年的数据，我们重点关注二氧化碳（CO2），发现不同地点和时段之间存在显著差异。美国中西部上游地区的边际排放率是美国西部地区的三倍以上；在同一区域内，某些时段的边际排放率是其他时段的两倍以上。我们将结果应用于插电式电动汽车（PEV）的评估。在美国西部和得克萨斯州，驾驶插电式电动汽车每英里的CO2排放量低于驾驶混合动力汽车。然而，在中西部上游地区，若在推荐的夜间时段充电，插电式电动汽车每英里产生的排放量高于目前路上行驶的平均汽车。我们的许多结果背后，隐含着电力负荷管理与环境目标之间的根本张力：电力生产成本最低的时段，往往也是排放最多的时段。除插电式电动汽车外，我们还展示了这些估计值如何用于评估分布式太阳能、能效提升和实时定价等其他政策与举措的异质性效应。

title: What Do We Know About Short-and Long-Term Effects of Early Life Exposure to Pollution?
abstract: Evidence shows that pollution exposure early in life is detrimental to near-term health, and an increasing body of evidence suggests that early-childhood health influences health and human capital outcomes later in life. This article reviews the economic research that brings these two literatures together. We begin with a conceptual model that highlights the core relationships across the life cycle. We then review the literature concerned with such estimates, focusing particularly on identification strategies to mitigate concerns regarding endogenous exposure. The nascent empirical literature provides both direct and indirect evidence that early-childhood exposure to pollution significantly impacts later-life outcomes. We discuss the potential policy implications of these long-lasting effects and conclude with a number of promising avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 证据表明，生命早期的污染暴露对近期健康有害，而且越来越多的证据表明，儿童早期的健康会影响其日后的健康和人力资本结果。本文回顾了将这两类文献结合起来的经济学研究。我们首先建立了一个概念模型，以突出贯穿整个生命周期的核心关系。随后，我们回顾了关于此类估计的文献，尤其关注用以减轻内生暴露顾虑的识别策略。新兴的实证文献既提供了直接证据，也提供了间接证据，表明儿童早期的污染暴露会显著影响日后的结果。我们讨论了这些持久影响的潜在政策含义，并以若干有前景的未来研究方向作结。

title: Cost Analysis of a Patient Navigation System to Increase Screening Colonoscopy Adherence among Urban Minorities
Environment, Health, and Human Capital
abstract: In this review, we discuss three major contributions economists have made to our understanding of the relationship between the environment and individual well-being. First, in explicitly recognizing how optimizing behavior, particularly in the form of residential sorting, can lead to non-random assignment of pollution, economists have employed a wide range of quasi-experimental techniques to develop causal estimates of the effect of pollution. Second, economic research has placed a considerable focus on the role of avoidance behavior, which is an important component for understanding the difference between biological and behavioral effects of pollution and for proper welfare calculations. Lastly, economic research has expanded the focus of analysis beyond traditional health outcomes to include measures of human capital, including labor supply, productivity, and cognition. Our review of the quasi-experimental evidence on this topic suggests that pollution does indeed have a wide range of effects on individual well-being, even at levels well below current regulatory standards. Given the importance of health and human capital as an engine for economic growth, these findings underscore the role of environmental conditions as an important factor of production.
abstract_zh: 在本综述中，我们讨论了经济学家对理解环境与个人福祉之间关系所做的三项主要贡献。第一，经济学家明确认识到，最优化行为（尤其是居住地选择）可能导致污染的非随机分配，因此运用了多种准实验方法，以得出污染影响的因果估计。第二，经济学研究十分关注规避行为的作用，这对于理解污染的生物效应与行为效应之间的差异，以及进行恰当的福利计算，都是重要组成部分。最后，经济学研究已将分析重点从传统的健康结果扩展到人力资本的衡量，包括劳动供给、生产率和认知能力。我们对该主题准实验证据的综述表明，即使在远低于当前监管标准的水平下，污染确实对个人福祉产生广泛影响。鉴于健康和人力资本作为经济增长引擎的重要性，这些发现强调了环境条件作为一种重要生产要素的作用。

title: Something in the Water: Contaminated Drinking Water and Infant Health
abstract: This paper provides estimates of the effects of in utero exposure to contaminated drinking water on fetal health. To do this, we examine the universe of birth records and drinking water testing results for the state of New Jersey from 1997 to 2007. Our data enable us to compare outcomes across siblings who were potentially exposed to differing levels of harmful contaminants from drinking water while in utero. We find small effects of drinking water contamination on all children, but large and statistically significant effects on birth weight and gestation of infants born to less educated mothers. We also show that those mothers who were most affected by contamination were the least likely to move between births in response to contamination.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了子宫内暴露于受污染饮用水对胎儿健康的影响。为此，我们考察了1997至2007年间新泽西州全部的出生记录以及饮用水检测结果。我们的数据使我们能够比较在子宫内可能暴露于不同水平有害饮用水污染物的兄弟姐妹之间的结局。我们发现，饮用水污染对所有儿童的影响较小，但对受教育程度较低的母亲所生婴儿的出生体重和孕周有较大且具有统计显著性的影响。我们还表明，受污染影响最大的母亲，在两次分娩之间因污染而迁居的可能性最小。

title: Environmental Policy and Political Realities: Fisheries Management & Job Creation in the Pacific Islands
abstract: Effective environmental policymaking requires an understanding of how environmental goals interact with other political goals. This article analyzes development strategies in the PICT’s, where policymakers aim to leverage tuna resources into sustainable economic development and job creation. The authors develop a model that analyzes costs and benefits of different development strategies, with a focus on job creation and local socioeconomic factors that drive optimal policy mixes across PICTs. The analysis demonstrates that investment in fisheries management can effectively encourage economic development and create employment opportunities, and compare this strategy to others such as selling access permits and investing in processing capacity. While many benefits of fisheries management are widely recognized, its ability to create high-quality employment opportunities is often overlooked. For many PICTs, this may represent the lowest cost strategy for jobs creation and, coupled with selling fishery access to foreign vessels, can form a strong basis for economic development plans.
abstract_zh: 有效的环境政策制定需要理解环境目标如何与其他政治目标相互作用。本文分析了太平洋岛屿国家和地区（PICTs）的发展战略，这些地区的政策制定者力图将金枪鱼资源转化为可持续的经济发展与就业创造。作者构建了一个模型，分析不同发展战略的成本与收益，重点关注就业创造以及驱动各太平洋岛屿国家和地区最优政策组合的当地社会经济因素。分析表明，对渔业管理的投资能够有效促进经济发展并创造就业机会，并将这一战略与出售捕捞许可证、投资加工能力等其他战略进行了比较。尽管渔业管理的诸多益处已得到广泛认可，但其创造高质量就业机会的能力却常常被忽视。对许多太平洋岛屿国家和地区而言，这可能是成本最低的就业创造战略；若与向外国船只出售渔业准入权相结合，则可以成为经济发展规划的坚实基础。

title: The Impact of Pollution on Worker Productivity
abstract: Environmental protection is typically cast as a tax on the labor market and the economy in general. Since a large body of evidence links pollution with poor health, and health is an important part of human capital, efforts to reduce pollution could plausibly be viewed as an investment in human capital and thus a tool for promoting economic growth. While a handful of studies have documented the impacts of pollution on labor supply, this paper is the first to rigorously assess the less visible but likely more pervasive impacts on worker productivity. In particular, we exploit a novel panel dataset of daily farm worker output as recorded under piece rate contracts merged with data on environmental conditions to relate the plausibly exogenous daily variations in ozone with worker productivity. We find robust evidence that ozone levels well below federal air quality standards have a significant impact on productivity: a 10 ppb decrease in ozone concentrations increases worker productivity by 4.2 percent.

abstract: This study uses a large sample of homes in the San Diego area and Sacramento, California area to provide some of the first capitalization estimates of the sales value of homes with solar panels relative to comparable homes without solar panels. Although the residential solar home market continues to grow, there is little direct evidence on the market capitalization effect. Using both hedonics and a repeat sales index approach we find that solar panels are capitalized at roughly a 3.5% premium. This premium is larger in communities with a greater share of college graduates and of registered Prius hybrid vehicles.

abstract: In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of informational regulatory approaches by analyzing the impact of smog alerts issued on consecutive days on discretionary outdoor activities in Southern California. Short-run adjustments to transitory risk entail costs that are likely to influence the set of evasive actions pursued by those at risk. Our results confirm that the cost of intertemporally substituting activities is increasing over time: when alerts are issued on two successive days, any response on the first day has largely disappeared by the second day. Small reprieves from alerts, however, reset these costs. Our findings imply that a time-varying decision rule that accounts for multiple day air quality forecasts may improve social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析加利福尼亚南部连续多日发布的烟雾预警对可自由支配户外活动的影响，考察了信息型监管方式的动态效应。短期内对暂时性风险的调整需要付出成本，这些成本很可能会影响风险人群所采取的规避行为组合。我们的结果证实，跨期替代活动的成本会随时间推移而上升：当连续两天发布预警时，第一天的任何应对行为到第二天大多已经消失。然而，预警的短暂中断会重置这些成本。我们的研究结果表明，考虑多日空气质量预测的时变决策规则可能会提高社会福利。

title: Insect Population Dynamics, Pesticide Use and Farmworker Health
abstract: We address the impacts of regulations designed to reduce pesticide poisoning of farmers and farm laborers. Attention is concentratedon pre‐harvest interval regulations that impose a time interval between pesticide application and harvest. The incidence of poisoning is determined by aggregate pesticide use, worker exposure, and toxicity. A dynamic, stochastic model of insect population growth is developed and used to measure the incentives for pesticide use. Increasing the pre‐harvest interval has an ambiguous effect on the number of harvest worker poisonings. Pesticide taxation unambiguously reduces the number of worker poisonings. Theoretical results are quantified in a case study of mevinphos application on leaf lettuce in California's Salinas Valley.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了旨在减少农场主和农业工人农药中毒的监管措施的影响。研究重点关注收获前间隔期监管，即规定农药施用与收获之间须间隔一定时间。中毒发生率取决于农药的总使用量、工人暴露程度以及毒性。我们构建了一个昆虫种群增长的动态随机模型，并用其衡量农药使用的激励。延长收获前间隔期对收获工人中毒人数的影响并不确定。农药征税则明确地减少了工人中毒人数。我们在加利福尼亚州萨利纳斯谷对叶用莴苣施用甲基磷（mevinphos）的案例研究中，对理论结果进行了量化。
